Hi! My name is Maggie Church. I am a Ph.D. candidate in the [Landscape Modeling lab](https://www.landscapemodeling.net/), led by Dr. Jessica O'Connell. My work focuses on applying remote sensing to better understand wetland dynamics at regional scales. Previously, I spent 4 years as a data analyst, and hiked the Appalachian and Pacific Crest Trails.
